verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's fully-featured CLI, including the `bw serve` local REST API, lets an agent script operations across the vault. Import and export move many items at once, and a hands-on report confirms `bw list` returns every item in one call. However, nothing in the evidence documents native bulk edit, move or delete, so bulk changes would rely on user-written scripting loops. Missing for 10: documented native bulk edit/move/delete commands or endpoints, and hands-on evidence of bulk modification workflows.
